text: dsh-empty-turn-guard 是 DSH Web 插件，用来处理模型只返回协议标记、没有正文或工具调用，却被当作正常结束的空回合。它观察 agent-loop 的 llm/stream 请求；遇到 stop、无工具调用且清理标记后正文为空时，将结果改成可重试的 EMPTY_RESPONSE。普通回复、工具调用和 max-tokens 截断会原样通过。插件默认启用，可在设置页或插件面板切换，也可通过配置关闭拦截。适合回复因协议残渣而静默中断的 DSH 用户；实现未要求 API 密钥或外部服务。

dsh-empty-turn-guard retries DSH turns that stop with protocol markup only. It watches agent-loop output and changes an empty stop into retryable EMPTY_RESPONSE. Normal text, tool calls, and token limits pass through. A settings switch controls it. No API key or external service is required.
模型只吐出 thinking 标签时，能不能自动重试？
DSH 回复半截就没了，我想让空白回合重新请求。
Can DSH retry when a model stop contains only leaked protocol tags?
dsh-empty-turn-guard 的功能「空回合重试」：当 agent-loop 流以 stop 结束、没有工具调用且正文除去协议标记后为空时，将 finish 改成 EMPTY_RESPONSE 错误，交给现有重试机制处理。
dsh-empty-turn-guard 的功能「设置开关」：用户可在设置插件页或插件面板切换 enabled，也可用配置关闭拦截；界面提供中英文标签并保存设置。

dsh-empty-turn-guard README · dsh-empty-turn-guard：**English** | [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md)

A small [DSH (DeepSeek-Harness)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) plugin for one
specific failure: the model replies with **nothing but leaked protocol markup** —
no prose, no tool call — and the harness treats that as a finished turn. This
plugin reclassifies it as a **retryable error** so the step is retried instead of
silently ending the turn.

It is a DSH **bundle** (a package with its own `cordis.patch.yml`) and installs
without touching any DSH file.

dsh-empty-turn-guard README · Features：- **Catches the "half an answer" turn.** When a reply ends with only
  `</｜｜DSML｜｜ calls>`, `<thinking> </thinking>`, or leftover punctuation, the
  step is retried with backoff instead of being committed as an answer.
- **Two settings entry points.** A dedicated tab under **Settings → Built-in
  plugins → Empty-turn guard**, and the same card on the sidebar **Plugins**
  panel. Both drive the same switch.
- **Cannot false-positive on real replies.** Three conditions must hold at once:
  the finish is `stop`, no tool call was observed, and the text is empty after
  markup removal. A one-word answer, a lone `?`, or prose that merely mentions a
  tag passes through untouched.
- **Leaves truncation alone.** `max-tokens` is a real answer cut short and already
  surfaces as its own visible outcome, so it is not touched.
- **No dependencies at runtime.** Host half imports only a schema library; the
  browser half is a hand-written bundle with no build step.
- **Logs the length, never the text.** Diagnostics carry `text=24ch`, so model
  output does not reach log files through this plugin.
dsh-empty-turn-guard README · Install：```sh
dsh-empty-turn-guard README · straight from GitHub (works today)：dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add github:FYTXY/dsh-empty-turn-guard
dsh-empty-turn-guard README · from a local checkout, for development：dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-empty-turn-guard

text:
dsh-empty-turn-guard README · 1. The switch：Both entry points write the same value — the package's entry in the profile's
`dsh.profile.bundles` array — so either works:

| Entry point | What it shows |
| --- | --- |
| Settings → Built-in plugins → **Empty-turn guard** | The plugin's own tab: the switch, what it currently does, and save / discard |
| Sidebar → **Plugins** panel | The same switch on the bundle's card |

dsh-empty-turn-guard README · 1. The switch：Turning it **off** unloads the plugin and restores the untouched `llm/stream`
chain, which brings the silent half-turn back. Turning it **on** reloads the
guard. Both take effect without reinstalling.

The row-level toggle for this plugin's row is greyed out on the Plugins panel.
That is expected: DSH only enables or disables *rows* through the profile's own
patch file, and this plugin's row comes from the bundle's own `cordis.patch.yml`.
The bundle switch is the one that takes effect.

dsh-empty-turn-guard README · 2. Disabling it without unloading：To keep the package installed but skip the interception, give the row a config:

```yaml
- id: dsh-empty-turn-guard
  name: 'dsh-empty-turn-guard'
  config:
    enabled: false

`enabled` is a volatile field, so it arrives as a live reference rather than a
frozen value; the guard re-reads it on every request and the settings switch
applies to the next model call with no restart.

dsh-empty-turn-guard README · 3. Verifying it is running：In the host log (`%APPDATA%\DSH Desktop\logs\host\dsh-<date>.log` on Windows,
`~/.config/DSH Desktop/logs/host/` on Linux):

```
[dsh-empty-turn-guard] empty-turn-guard: mounted (markup-only stops become EMPTY_RESPONSE retries)
```

And when a markup-only stop is actually caught:

```
[dsh-empty-turn-guard] rewriting an empty stop (text=24ch) into EMPTY_RESPONSE
```

An `llm/retry` / `llm/retry-started` event usually follows — that is the retry
running.

dsh-empty-turn-guard README · How it works：```
LLM call
  └─ llm/stream  ◀── this plugin wraps here (global, prepended)
     └─ adapter stream (openai-responses | anthropic-messages)
        └─ chunks: block-start / text-delta / block-end / usage / finish

dsh-empty-turn-guard README · How it works：`llm/stream` is the single funnel every model call passes through, and the
waterfall lets a listener wrap the provider's chunk stream instead of reacting
after the fact. Rewriting the `finish` chunk — rather than editing text or
injecting a message — keeps the conversation history clean and reuses the retry
machinery the provider already declares.

dsh-empty-turn-guard README · How it works：Two filters keep the interception narrow. Requests that declare no tools are
skipped, because background calls (session titles, compaction) stream the same
way and an empty reply there is expected. `max-tokens` is skipped because a
truncated answer is a genuine answer.

The failure this targets, the measurements behind it, and why switching protocol
does not help are documented in **[docs/root-cause.md](docs/root-cause.md)**.

dsh-empty-turn-guard README · Compatibility：- **DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`** (verified on this release).
- **Node.js >= 22.**
- Uses only existing seams: the `llm/stream` waterfall and the `EMPTY_RESPONSE`
  error code. No DSH file is modified.
- `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` is a **peer dependency** supplied by DSH.
- The schema keeps a `.volatile()` field on purpose. `@deepseek-ai/dsh-settings`
  drops any namespace whose schema has none — silently — and the settings card
  would vanish. See the note at the end of
  [docs/root-cause.md](docs/root-cause.md).

dsh-empty-turn-guard README · Non-goals：- **Does not repair the relay.** The markup still reaches the message body; it
  just no longer pretends to be a finished turn.
- **Does not sanitise history.** Messages already on disk keep their residue.
- **Does not handle degenerate repetition.** A reply that loops until
  `max-tokens` already shows up as its own visible outcome.
- **Does not guarantee the retry succeeds.** If the relay only ever returns
  residue, the retries are exhausted and you get a clear error — still better
  than a silent half-answer.

dsh-empty-turn-guard README · Development：There is no build step. `lib/index.js` and `lib/client.js` are the shipped
artifacts.

```sh
npm run check   # node --check on both entry points
npm test        # node --test over tests/
```

`lib/client.js` is a hand-written ModuleLoader bundle because the browser runner
loads it by evaluating `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })`. It may
require only `react`, `react/jsx-runtime` and
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`. Do not introduce a bundler for it.

dsh-empty-turn-guard README · Development：See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for the review bar, and
[SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) for the plugin's security boundaries.

dsh-empty-turn-guard README · Repository Layout：```
dsh-empty-turn-guard/
├── lib/index.js           # host half: the llm/stream guard (no runtime deps)
├── lib/client.js          # browser half: the settings card + plugins card
├── cordis.patch.yml       # bundle patch: mounts the plugin row

dsh-empty-turn-guard README · Uninstall：```sh
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> remove dsh-empty-turn-guard
```

Or turn the switch off in **Settings → Built-in plugins → Empty-turn guard**.

dsh-empty-turn-guard README · dsh-empty-turn-guard：[English](./README.md) | **简体中文**

给 [DSH（DeepSeek-Harness）](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) 用的一个小插件，只针对一种失败：模型回复**只剩协议残渣**——既没有正文、也没有工具调用——而 DSH 把这当成"正常说完了"。本插件把它改判成一个**可重试的错误**，让这一步重试，而不是静默结束回合。

它是一个标准 DSH **bundle**（自带 `cordis.patch.yml` 的包），安装不修改 DSH 任何文件。

dsh-empty-turn-guard README · 特性：- **拦住"半截回答"那一轮。** 当回复只剩 `</｜｜DSML｜｜ calls>`、`<thinking> </thinking>` 或纯标点时，这一步会带退避重试，而不是被当成一条完整消息落盘。
- **两处设置入口。** **设置 → 内置插件 →「空回合守卫」** 一个独立 tab，以及侧边栏 **「插件」** 面板上的同名卡片，改的是同一个开关。
- **不会误伤正常回复。** 三个条件必须同时成立：结束原因是 `stop`、没有观察到任何工具调用、去掉协议标记后正文为空。单词回答、单个 `?`、只是提到了标签的正常文字，都原样放行。
- **不碰截断。** `max-tokens` 是"真回答被截短"，本来就是可见的独立结果，不归本插件管。
- **零运行时依赖。** 宿主半只引一个 schema 库；浏览器半是手写 bundle，不需要构建工具。
- **日志只记长度，不记内容。** 诊断信息里是 `text=24ch`，模型输出不会经本插件写进日志文件。

text:
dsh-empty-turn-guard README · 1. 开关：两个入口改的是同一件事（profile `package.json` 里 `dsh.profile.bundles` 的这一项），用哪个都行：

| 入口 | 展示内容 |
| --- | --- |
| 设置 → 内置插件 → **「空回合守卫」** | 插件自己的配置页：开关、当前状态说明、保存 / 丢弃 |
| 侧边栏 → **「插件」** 面板 | bundle 卡片上的同一个开关 |

**关掉**会卸载本插件、`llm/stream` 恢复原样（空回合又会静默完成）；**打开**会重新加载守卫。两者都不需要重装、立即生效。

插件面板里本插件那一**行**的开关是灰色的，这是正常的：DSH 只允许通过 profile 自己的 patch 文件启停"行"，而本插件的行来自包自带的 `cordis.patch.yml`，所以行开关锁定——真正生效的是**包的开关**。

dsh-empty-turn-guard README · 2. 只禁用逻辑、保留安装：想留着包但跳过拦截，给这一行加 `config`：

```yaml
- id: dsh-empty-turn-guard
  name: 'dsh-empty-turn-guard'
  config:
    enabled: false

`enabled` 是 volatile 字段，运行时是活引用而不是冻结值；守卫每次请求都会重读它，所以设置页拨开关对下一次模型请求就生效，无需重启。

dsh-empty-turn-guard README · 3. 确认它生效了：宿主日志（Windows：`%APPDATA%\DSH Desktop\logs\host\dsh-<日期>.log`；Linux：`~/.config/DSH Desktop/logs/host/`）里会出现：

```
[dsh-empty-turn-guard] empty-turn-guard: mounted (markup-only stops become EMPTY_RESPONSE retries)
```

真的拦到一次空回合时：

```
[dsh-empty-turn-guard] rewriting an empty stop (text=24ch) into EMPTY_RESPONSE
```

紧接着通常还能看到 `llm/retry` / `llm/retry-started`——那就是重试在跑。

dsh-empty-turn-guard README · 工作原理：```
LLM 调用
  └─ llm/stream  ◀── 本插件包在这里（global，前置）
     └─ 适配器流（openai-responses | anthropic-messages）
        └─ 分块：block-start / text-delta / block-end / usage / finish

`llm/stream` 是每次模型调用都要过的唯一漏斗，瀑布式事件允许监听者**包裹**适配器的分块流，而不是事后修补。改写 `finish` 分块——而不是改文字或往对话里插消息——能保持历史干净，并直接复用 provider 已经声明的重试机制。

两个过滤条件让拦截保持克制：没有声明 `tools` 的请求直接跳过（标题生成、压缩这类后台调用走同一条流，空回复是正常的）；`max-tokens` 跳过（截断是真实回答）。

它针对的失败形态、背后的实测数据、以及"换协议为什么不管用"，都写在 **[docs/root-cause.md](docs/root-cause.md)**。

dsh-empty-turn-guard README · 兼容性：- **DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`**（在该版本验证通过）。
- **Node.js >= 22。**
- 只用既有接缝：`llm/stream` 瀑布与 `EMPTY_RESPONSE` 错误码，不修改 DSH 任何文件。
- `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` 是**对等依赖**，由 DSH 提供。
- `Config` 里必须保留 `.volatile()` 字段：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-settings` 会静默丢弃没有任何 volatile 字段的命名空间，设置卡片会消失。详见 [docs/root-cause.md](docs/root-cause.md) 末尾。

dsh-empty-turn-guard README · 非目标：- **不修中转站**：残渣仍会出现在正文里，只是不再"假装完成"。
- **不清洗历史消息**：已经落盘的怪标记不会被动。
- **不管退化刷屏**：一路重复到 `max-tokens` 的情况本来就有可见结果。
- **不保证重试一定成功**：如果中转持续只吐残渣，重试会耗尽并给出明确报错——仍好过静默半截。

dsh-empty-turn-guard README · 开发：没有构建步骤，`lib/index.js` 与 `lib/client.js` 就是发布产物。

```sh
npm run check   # 对两个入口跑 node --check
npm test        # 对 tests/ 跑 node --test
```

`lib/client.js` 是手写的 ModuleLoader bundle，因为浏览器侧是通过求值 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` 加载的。它只允许 `require` 三样东西：`react`、`react/jsx-runtime`、`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`。不要为它引入打包器。

评审标准见 [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)，安全边界见 [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md)。

dsh-empty-turn-guard README · 目录结构：```
dsh-empty-turn-guard/
├── lib/index.js           # 宿主半：llm/stream 守卫（零运行时依赖）
├── lib/client.js          # 浏览器半：设置页 / 插件面板的卡片
├── cordis.patch.yml       # bundle patch：把插件行挂进配置树

dsh-empty-turn-guard README · 卸载：```sh
dsh plugin --profile <你的profile> remove dsh-empty-turn-guard
```

或者去 **设置 → 内置插件 →「空回合守卫」** 把开关关掉。
